source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide how a cell's shape, size, and structure help it perform its specific function.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Nerve cells are long because carrying messages stretches them.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Cheek cells and nerve cells in the same person have the same shape and function.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The long nerve cell moves food down the food pipe because both are long.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Nerve cells carry messages by contracting and pushing the messages forward.

intelligence.enrichment: The unique shape, size, and structure of cells help them carry out specific functions: thin flat cheek cells form a protective lining, elongated nerve cells carry messages, and muscle cells contract to help move food. Specialized cell shape and structure -> suitable action by that cell -> body function is carried out. The learner correctly applies this rule: The unique shape, size, and structure of cells help them carry out specific functions: thin flat cheek cells form a protective lining, elongated nerve cells carry messages, and muscle cells contract to help move food. All animal cells do the same job because they are all cells from the same body.
